item.description: - OpenCode support: its sessions show in your workspaces as working or idle, with a Usage card for its tokens, models and estimated cost. Add Dashbar's plugin in Settings → Integrations to also see when a session is waiting for you. - Settings → Integrations is shorter: one section per tool, each with its Add or Remove button, and the details of what Dashbar changes folded underneath.

- **Desktop widgets**: add Dashbar from the widget gallery (right-click the desktop, Edit Widgets). The small one shows Claude's 5-hour and weekly limits and when they reset, the medium one each tool's limits and how many agents are working. When Dashbar isn't running they dim and say since when

- An account whose folder doesn't exist no longer counts as a second account, so Dashbar stops naming everything "Claude · Personal" when you only use one. Settings → Accounts marks it "Folder not found" and keeps it, and Dashbar starts reading it within a minute of the folder appearing - A permission prompt that was settled some other way, by the app you run Claude Code in or by Claude Code denying it on its own, now leaves Dashbar's notch and panel straight away instead of staying until its timer runs out
